notes: Valid portable Skill: standard frontmatter, specific description, one conditional reference with an explicit retrieval condition, observable completion condition, no scripts or platform coupling.
history: 2026-08-15: reviewers running EX-007 correctly raised two real defects in the original version — `git log --merges` silently returns nothing on squash-merging repositories, and 'if the repository defines a house format' named no detectable signal. Those were fixture defects, not reviewer false positives, and were fixed. A false-positive control only works if the control is actually clean.
